historical_retry_control.finding: The existing control accepts legacy prepared records with no step evidence, gets genuine rebased acceptance, reopens the Runtime, and asserts exact lookup equality, absent v2 metadata and zero integrity errors. It does not rewrite database rows.
historical_retry_control.implementation: Coordinator lookup precedes provider execution. TimelineCommitStore._lookup checks original publisher-bound hash and verifies stored row/edge, then returns _envelope. _verify_accepted allows authentic historical rebased and new merged, retaining event chain/records/head checks. No stored envelope is normalized.
